source_text: Reversus est Iesus in Galgala cum omni Israel — ad locum circumcisionis et paschae. Post victorias redeundum ad sacramenta. Gloria. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Returned is Jesus into Gilgal with all Israel — unto place of-circumcision and of-passover. After victories it-must-be-returned unto sacraments. Glory. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus returned to Gilgal with all Israel >> Bible:Joshua 10:43]] — to circumcision’s and Passover’s place. After victories return to the sacraments. Glory. Amen.
